newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Recalled ambassadors brief EU on Iran.
newsitem.headline: Recalled ambassadors brief EU on Iran.

text.p: European Union ambassadors to Iran briefed the Council's Middle East working group on Thursday on Tehran's reaction to their withdrawal last week and to the end of the bloc's critical dialogue policy.
The envoys were recalled after a German court found that the Iranian leadership had ordered the killing of Kurdish opposition activists.

Diplomats said the ambassadors were asked to offer their thoughts ahead of the General Affairs Council on April 29 at which foreign ministers will discuss Iran for the first time since the court finding.
"So far the reaction (from Iran) has been relatively modest," one EU diplomat said.
As well as recalling their ambassadors, EU countries also ended their critical dialogue with Tehran, a policy of trying to build links while making clear the bloc's determination to oppose terrorism.
The diplomat said the envoys and officials were also to discuss the reaction of other countries to the EU moves, notably of the United States.
Washington has long viewed Iran as a pariah state and disapproved of the EU's critical dialogue policy.
